title: ClientError::Parse and ::Serialize asymmetry is undocumented
description: ClientError has two variants wrapping serde_json::Error: Parse (no #[from]) and Serialize (#[from]). The asymmetry is necessary — Rust cannot derive two From<serde_json::Error> impls — but it is not documented. Callers who try to use ? on a serde_json::from_* call inside a function returning Result<_, ClientError> get a confusing compile error about missing From impl. The doc comments on both variants should explain: Serialize has From, Parse does not; use .map_err(ClientError::Parse) for deserialization.
